verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Ollama serves an llms.txt at https://ollama.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented summary, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Other agent-friendly formats were not found: docs.md and OpenAPI paths returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth and coverage beyond the header, markdown-rendered docs (docs.md 404), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, first-party documentation of the llms.txt, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://ollama.com/llms.txt # Ollama
